This is the first release of the Meridian Environmental Liability wording. It is new to the Commons and replaces no earlier wording.

- Two sections. Contractors Pollution Liability covers claims and clean-up costs from pollution caused by work at other people's sites. Site Pollution Legal Liability covers pollution on, at, under or migrating from the locations shown in the schedule, and applies only if the schedule shows it.
- Claims-made and notified, with a retroactive date for each section, notification of circumstances under s.40(3) of the Insurance Contracts Act 1984 (Cth), and an automatic 90-day extended reporting period on cancellation or non-renewal, with up to three years available to buy.
- Gradual pollution, clean-up costs required by environmental law, natural resource damage and emergency response costs are covered. Defence costs are within the limit.
- The policy is written to sit with the Meridian Public and Products Liability wording: primary for gradual pollution and clean-up, and excess of public liability for sudden and accidental personal injury and property damage.
- Asbestos, mould and PFAS are excluded. Asbestos abatement work can be written back by Endorsement E05.
- Seven endorsements, each with operative text, schedule variables and a platform trigger: Pre-existing Conditions, Transported Cargo, Non-owned Disposal Sites, Project Term, Asbestos Abatement, Prior Acts and Business Interruption.
- General conditions include an express Insurance Contracts Act savings clause applying s.54 to every obligation, individual treatment of insureds, fixed governing law and jurisdiction, and a standalone sanctions condition.
- Licensed CC BY 4.0. Clauses are identified by their headings, not numbers.
